ISSUE 01 / OCTOBER 2026
REFERENCE ARCHIVE

Behind the image
59 / Slate Collar
REFERENCE 5844.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 044
Art direction: Gray and powder blue against warm mahogany, academic heritage, soft directional
light.
Photorealistic vertical three-quarter fashion editorial of an original adult East Asian woman with
long, wavy dark brown hair parted in the center, soft glossy pink lips and a calm direct gaze, one
hand resting at her collar and the other holding a small ivory keepsake case tied with a long black
satin ribbon. She wears a fitted gray knit cardigan with a pale sky-blue shirt collar and cuffs, dark
domed buttons and a ribbed waistband, and a charcoal pleated mini skirt. Warm mahogany
wood-paneled wall, soft diffused side light, gray, powder blue and walnut palette, classic preppy
mood, no text or logos.
60 / Heart Bag
REFERENCE 5843.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 045
Art direction: Black and white contrast, jewel buttons, ribbon details, warm wood-paneled interior.
Photorealistic vertical three-quarter fashion editorial of an original adult East Asian woman with
long, wavy dark brown hair parted in the center, a composed gaze and soft rose lips, standing in a
wood-paneled room with a carved wooden chair behind her. She wears a fitted black
cardigan-style jacket with a crisp white pointed collar, white cuffs and small jeweled buttons, and a
black pleated mini skirt, and holds a heart-shaped blush-beige quilted bag decorated with long
black satin ribbon bows. Warm mahogany paneling, a tall window with pale light on the left, soft
diffused light, black, ivory and walnut palette, vintage schoolhouse romance, no text or logos.
